title: Cofinality of the apex projection for cocones in a filtered quasicategory
statement:
Use universes, smallness, regular cardinals and filteredness of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], and coherent cocone categories, simplicial pullbacks and weak contractibility of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\kappa$ be an infinite regular cardinal, let $E$ be a small $\kappa$-filtered quasicategory, let $K$ be a $\kappa$-small simplicial set and let $p:K\to E$ be a coherent diagram. Put $T=E_{p/}$ and let $V:T\to E$ be the apex projection. Then $T$ is small and $\kappa$-filtered. For every $e\in E$, form the coherent comma quasicategory
$$(e\downarrow V)=\{e\}\times_{E,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,E)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,E}T.$$
There is an equivalence $(e\downarrow V)\simeq E_{(p\amalg e)/}$ compatible with apex projections, where $p\amalg e:K\amalg\Delta^0\to E$ restricts to $p$ and to $e$. Consequently every $(e\downarrow V)$ is $\kappa$-filtered and weakly contractible, so $V$ satisfies the cofinal comma criterion. No colimit-existence hypothesis on $E$ is imposed, and $K=\varnothing$ is allowed.
